parameters.content: ## WF05 Responsibility\n\nWF05 owns deterministic follow-up sequence initialization and scheduled follow-up execution. It preserves database scheduling as the source of truth.

## Dual Entry Architecture

Execute Sub-workflow Trigger initializes a sequence from WF04.

Schedule Trigger processes only already-created due followups every 15 minutes. The cadence is assessment/demo configuration.

## Follow-Up Schedule Configuration

Qualified: immediate, +24h, +72h.
Nurture: +24h, +72h, +7d.

All steps use one sequence anchor. These timings are explicit assessment/demo configuration.
## Stop Conditions\n\nStop before every action for reply, booking, opt-out, manual close, manual review, completion, missing lead, or routing state that no longer allows follow-up.

## Idempotency & Concurrency\n\nUNIQUE (lead_id, sequence_type, step_number) prevents duplicate schedules. Execution idempotency plus an atomic scheduled → executed transition prevents duplicate processing.

## Messaging Boundary\n\nThis assessment implementation records a simulated outbound follow-up action. Real WhatsApp/email/SMS delivery is intentionally deferred and can replace the simulated action without changing sequence-state, scheduling, stop-condition, or idempotency logic.

parameters.jsCode: const lead=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify($json??{}));const required=[['lead_id',lead.lead_id],['source',lead.source],['contact',lead.contact],['business',lead.business],['qualification',lead.qualification],['processing',lead.processing]];const missing=required.filter(([,v])=>v==null||v==='').map(([k])=>k);if(missing.length)throw new Error('Invalid WF05 handoff: missing '+missing.join(', '));lead.processing={...lead.processing,current_workflow:'WF05_followup_engine',updated_at:new Date().toISOString()};lead.execution_context={entry:'handoff'};return[{json:lead}];

parameters.jsCode: const lead=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify($json.input_lead??$json.lead??{}));const db=$json.database_lead;if(!db?.id)throw new Error('Authoritative lead not found: '+(lead.lead_id??'unknown'));lead.lead_id=db.id;lead.qualification={...(lead.qualification??{}),final_status:db.final_status??lead.qualification?.final_status};lead.processing={...(lead.processing??{}),status:db.processing_status??lead.processing?.status,current_workflow:'WF05_followup_engine',updated_at:new Date().toISOString()};lead.crm={...(lead.crm??{}),stage:db.crm_stage??lead.crm?.stage,next_action:db.next_action??lead.crm?.next_action};lead.routing={...(lead.routing??{}),assigned_sales_rep_id:db.assigned_sales_rep_id??lead.routing?.assigned_sales_rep_id??null,priority:db.priority??lead.routing?.priority};return[{json:lead}];

const lead=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify($json));const CONFIG={qualified_followup:[{step:1,delay_minutes:0},{step:2,delay_minutes:1440},{step:3,delay_minutes:4320}],nurture:[{step:1,delay_minutes:1440},{step:2,delay_minutes:4320},{step:3,delay_minutes:10080}]};const anchor=new Date();const sequence=lead.follow_up?.sequence;const config=CONFIG[sequence];if(!config)throw new Error('Unsupported follow-up sequence: '+sequence);lead.sequence_schedule={sequence_type:sequence,sequence_started_at:anchor.toISOString(),steps:config.map(x=>({step_number:x.step,scheduled_at:new Date(anchor.getTime()+x.delay_minutes*60000).toISOString(),idempotency_key:'followup:'+lead.lead_id+':'+sequence+':'+x.step}))};return[{json:lead}];

parameters.query:
WITH i AS(
 SELECT $1::jsonb j
),steps AS(
 SELECT x FROM i,LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(j#>'{sequence_schedule,steps}')x
),keys AS(
 INSERT INTO idempotency_keys(key,operation,lead_id,status,created_at)
 SELECT x->>'idempotency_key','followup_execution',(j->>'lead_id')::uuid,'scheduled',now()
 FROM i,steps
 ON CONFLICT(key)DO NOTHING
 RETURNING key
),ins AS(
 INSERT INTO followups(lead_id,sequence_type,step_number,scheduled_at,executed_at,status,idempotency_key,created_at)
 SELECT (j->>'lead_id')::uuid,j#>>'{sequence_schedule,sequence_type}',(x->>'step_number')::int,(x->>'scheduled_at')::timestamptz,NULL,'scheduled',x->>'idempotency_key',now()
 FROM i,steps
 WHERE(SELECT count(*)FROM keys)>=0
 ON CONFLICT(lead_id,sequence_type,step_number)DO NOTHING
 RETURNING lead_id,sequence_type,step_number,scheduled_at,status,idempotency_key
),persisted AS(
 SELECT f.lead_id,f.sequence_type,f.step_number,f.scheduled_at,f.status,f.idempotency_key
 FROM followups f,i
 WHERE f.lead_id=(j->>'lead_id')::uuid AND f.sequence_type=j#>>'{sequence_schedule,sequence_type}'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT lead_id,sequence_type,step_number,scheduled_at,status,idempotency_key FROM ins
),authoritative AS(
 SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'sequence_type',p.sequence_type,
  'sequence_started_at',CASE WHEN p.sequence_type='qualified_followup' THEN min(p.scheduled_at) ELSE min(p.scheduled_at)-interval '1440 minutes' END,
  'steps',jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('step_number',p.step_number,'scheduled_at',p.scheduled_at,'idempotency_key',p.idempotency_key,'status',p.status)ORDER BY p.step_number)
 )schedule
 FROM persisted p
 GROUP BY p.sequence_type
),audit AS(
 INSERT INTO lead_events(lead_id,event_type,workflow_name,execution_id,payload,created_at)
 SELECT (j->>'lead_id')::uuid,'followup_sequence_initialized','WF05_followup_engine',$2,jsonb_build_object('sequence_type',j#>>'{sequence_schedule,sequence_type}','sequence_started_at',(SELECT schedule->>'sequence_started_at'FROM authoritative),'step_count',3),now()
 FROM i
 WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ins)AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM lead_events e WHERE e.lead_id=(j->>'lead_id')::uuid AND e.event_type='followup_sequence_initialized'AND e.payload->>'sequence_type'=j#>>'{sequence_schedule,sequence_type}')
)
SELECT jsonb_set(i.j,'{sequence_schedule}',authoritative.schedule,true)lead,(SELECT count(*)FROM ins)inserted_count
FROM i,authoritative;

SELECT $1::jsonb input_lead,CASE WHEN l.id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE to_jsonb(l)END database_lead,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bookings b WHERE b.lead_id=$2::uuid AND b.status IN('scheduled','confirmed','success','booked'))booking_exists,COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(e.event_type)FROM lead_events e WHERE e.lead_id=$2::uuid AND e.event_type IN('customer_replied','customer_reply','customer_opted_out','opt_out','manual_close','lead_manually_closed')),'[]'::jsonb)event_types,NULL::jsonb due_followup FROM(SELECT 1)a LEFT JOIN leads l ON l.id=$2::uuid;

SELECT to_jsonb(f)due_followup
FROM followups f
JOIN idempotency_keys k ON k.key=f.idempotency_key
WHERE f.scheduled_at<=now()
 AND((f.status='scheduled'AND k.status='scheduled')OR(f.status='processing'AND k.status='processing'AND k.expires_at<=now()))
ORDER BY f.scheduled_at,f.step_number,f.id
LIMIT 50;

SELECT jsonb_build_object('lead_id',f.lead_id,'source',jsonb_build_object('type',l.source),'contact',jsonb_build_object('name',l.name,'phone_normalized',l.phone_normalized,'email_normalized',l.email_normalized),'business',jsonb_build_object('company_name',l.company_name,'service_interest',l.service_interest,'country',l.country),'qualification',jsonb_build_object('final_status',l.final_status),'processing',jsonb_build_object('status',l.processing_status,'current_workflow','WF05_followup_engine'),'crm',jsonb_build_object('stage',l.crm_stage,'next_action',l.next_action),'routing',jsonb_build_object('assigned_sales_rep_id',l.assigned_sales_rep_id,'priority',l.priority),'follow_up',jsonb_build_object('sequence',f.sequence_type))input_lead,CASE WHEN l.id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE to_jsonb(l)END database_lead,to_jsonb(f)due_followup,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bookings b WHERE b.lead_id=f.lead_id AND b.status IN('scheduled','confirmed','success','booked'))booking_exists,COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(e.event_type)FROM lead_events e WHERE e.lead_id=f.lead_id AND e.event_type IN('customer_replied','customer_reply','customer_opted_out','opt_out','manual_close','lead_manually_closed')),'[]'::jsonb)event_types FROM followups f LEFT JOIN leads l ON l.id=f.lead_id WHERE f.id=($1::jsonb->>'id')::uuid;

WITH i AS(
 SELECT $1::jsonb j
),u AS(
 UPDATE followups
 SET status='cancelled'
 FROM i
 WHERE followups.lead_id=(j->>'lead_id')::uuid
  AND followups.sequence_type=COALESCE(j#>>'{followup_candidate,sequence_type}',j#>>'{follow_up,sequence}')
  AND(
   followups.status='scheduled'
   OR(
    followups.status='processing'
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM idempotency_keys k WHERE k.key=followups.idempotency_key AND k.status='processing'AND k.expires_at<=now())
   )
  )
 RETURNING id
),e AS(
 INSERT INTO lead_events(lead_id,event_type,workflow_name,execution_id,payload,created_at)
 SELECT (j->>'lead_id')::uuid,'followup_sequence_stopped','WF05_followup_engine',$2,jsonb_build_object('sequence_type',COALESCE(j#>>'{followup_candidate,sequence_type}',j#>>'{follow_up,sequence}'),'stop_reason',j#>>'{stop_evaluation,stop_reason}','cancelled_count',(SELECT count(*)FROM u)),now()
 FROM i
 WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM lead_events x WHERE x.lead_id=(j->>'lead_id')::uuid AND x.event_type='followup_sequence_stopped'AND x.payload->>'sequence_type'=COALESCE(j#>>'{followup_candidate,sequence_type}',j#>>'{follow_up,sequence}'))
)
SELECT i.j lead,(SELECT count(*)FROM u)cancelled_count FROM i;

SELECT $1::jsonb lead,(
 SELECT to_jsonb(f)
 FROM followups f
 JOIN idempotency_keys k ON k.key=f.idempotency_key
 WHERE f.lead_id=($1::jsonb->>'lead_id')::uuid
  AND f.sequence_type=$1::jsonb#>>'{follow_up,sequence}'
  AND f.scheduled_at<=now()
  AND((f.status='scheduled'AND k.status='scheduled')OR(f.status='processing'AND k.status='processing'AND k.expires_at<=now()))
 ORDER BY f.step_number,f.scheduled_at
 LIMIT 1
)due_followup;

WITH i AS(
 SELECT $1::jsonb j
),candidate AS(
 SELECT f.id,k.key
 FROM followups f
 JOIN idempotency_keys k ON k.key=f.idempotency_key
 JOIN i ON true
 WHERE f.id=(i.j#>>'{followup_candidate,id}')::uuid
  AND f.scheduled_at<=now()
  AND((f.status='scheduled'AND k.status='scheduled')OR(f.status='processing'AND k.status='processing'AND k.expires_at<=now()))
 FOR UPDATE OF f,k SKIP LOCKED
),key_claim AS(
 UPDATE idempotency_keys
 SET status='processing',expires_at=now()+interval '5 minutes'
 FROM candidate
 WHERE idempotency_keys.key=candidate.key
 RETURNING idempotency_keys.key,idempotency_keys.status
),followup_claim AS(
 UPDATE followups
 SET status='processing'
 FROM candidate,key_claim
 WHERE followups.id=candidate.id
 RETURNING followups.id
)
SELECT i.j lead,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM followup_claim)should_execute,COALESCE((SELECT status FROM key_claim),(SELECT status FROM idempotency_keys k WHERE k.key=i.j#>>'{followup_candidate,idempotency_key}'),'missing')existing_status
FROM i;

parameters.jsCode: const lead=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify($json.lead??$json));const f=lead.followup_candidate;if(!f)throw new Error('Missing due follow-up candidate');const templates={qualified_followup:{1:'Sales follow-up reminder for qualified lead.',2:'Second sales follow-up reminder.',3:'Final automated sales follow-up before escalation.'},nurture:{1:'Initial nurture follow-up.',2:'Second nurture follow-up.',3:'Final nurture follow-up.'}};lead.outbound_action={channel:'simulated',operation:'followup_message',lead_id:lead.lead_id,sequence_type:f.sequence_type,step_number:f.step_number,idempotency_key:f.idempotency_key,message_template:templates[f.sequence_type]?.[f.step_number]};return[{json:lead}];

WITH i AS(
 SELECT $1::jsonb j
),u AS(
 UPDATE followups
 SET status='executed',executed_at=now()
 FROM i
 WHERE followups.id=(j#>>'{followup_candidate,id}')::uuid
  AND followups.status='processing'
  AND followups.scheduled_at<=now()
  AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM idempotency_keys k WHERE k.key=j#>>'{followup_candidate,idempotency_key}'AND k.status='processing')
 RETURNING followups.*
),idem AS(
 UPDATE idempotency_keys
 SET status='completed',expires_at=NULL,lead_id=(i.j->>'lead_id')::uuid,response_reference=u.id::text
 FROM i,u
 WHERE idempotency_keys.key=i.j#>>'{followup_candidate,idempotency_key}'AND idempotency_keys.status='processing'
 RETURNING idempotency_keys.key
),e AS(
 INSERT INTO lead_events(lead_id,event_type,workflow_name,execution_id,payload,created_at)
 SELECT u.lead_id,'followup_executed','WF05_followup_engine',$2,jsonb_build_object('sequence_type',u.sequence_type,'step_number',u.step_number,'scheduled_at',u.scheduled_at,'executed_at',u.executed_at,'idempotency_key',u.idempotency_key,'channel','simulated'),now()
 FROM u,idem
)
SELECT i.j lead,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM u)execution_persisted,(SELECT step_number FROM u)executed_step
FROM i;

WITH i AS(SELECT $1::jsonb j),r AS(SELECT count(*)::int n FROM followups f,i WHERE f.lead_id=(j->>'lead_id')::uuid AND f.sequence_type=j#>>'{followup_candidate,sequence_type}' AND f.status='scheduled'),e AS(INSERT INTO lead_events(lead_id,event_type,workflow_name,execution_id,payload,created_at)SELECT (j->>'lead_id')::uuid,'followup_sequence_completed','WF05_followup_engine',$2,jsonb_build_object('sequence_type',j#>>'{followup_candidate,sequence_type}'),now()FROM i,r WHERE r.n=0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM lead_events x WHERE x.lead_id=(j->>'lead_id')::uuid AND x.event_type='followup_sequence_completed' AND x.payload->>'sequence_type'=j#>>'{followup_candidate,sequence_type}'))SELECT i.j lead,r.n remaining_count,($1::jsonb#>>'{followup_candidate,step_number}')::int executed_step FROM i,r;
